purpose: Recurring measured RuVector research toward independently verified official SOTA
engine: Native @ruvector/typesafe@0.2.0 BGE-small + source-pinned104 validators, with any independently reviewed transferable learned head

data_roles.old183: Repeated adaptive public development only; previous train106/dev43/calibration34 split is not fresh generalization evidence
data_roles.easy48: Consumed by initial epoch confirmation. Never reuse for future first-use confirmation, model selection, calibration or a fresh gain claim
data_roles.future_confirmation: Require new unused question identities, source groups and normalized request hashes; freeze recipe before exposing labels
data_roles.synthetic: Software and semantic diagnostics only, not official benchmark replacement
data_roles.publisher_sealed: Only publisher evaluation can establish official score/rank; never acquire sealed answer keys

epoch_protocol: Refresh actual official rules, target and prior submission status through read-only sources
Load reviewed prior-epoch evidence and preserve failed hypotheses
Choose one new transferable hypothesis and freeze its source, train/calibration roles, data identities and resource limits
Run real native RuVector and paired baseline on identical literal inference requests
Promote development candidates only with retained accuracy, proper-score gains and zero invalid responses
Evaluate one frozen candidate on one unused confirmation draw exactly once
Obtain independent source, runtime, wire, scoring and paired uncertainty review
Publish only accepted public artifacts; official resubmission requires an actual improved candidate and preserves all historical references
Checkpoint completed and failed attempts; create next epoch only with a new hypothesis or new unused confirmation data
stop_conditions: No new evidence-bearing hypothesis or unused confirmation data
note: This template does not execute or schedule work. A connected executor and an observed running task are required for claims of ongoing execution.
